items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: The interviewee Ernest McLean does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Joe Merez is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: I don't know if they ever did bring those records?
Probably didn't come out. I'm not familiar with it. That's what I was trying to think. Uh-huh. Of course, Johnny St. Cyr made some for Southland record, Joe Merez.
Yes, who he was? Joe Merez?
